pick.headline: Alexander Dubcek elected chairman of the Czechoslovak parliament
pick.summary: On December 28, 1989, Alexander Dubcek, leader of the 1968 Prague Spring, was elected chairman of the Federal Assembly of Czechoslovakia.
pick.significance: The return of the man deposed by the Soviet invasion completed the symbolism of the Velvet Revolution.
pick.fbis: The East Europe report of December 29, 1989, carried Prague radio in Slovak: the Federal Assembly had elected Alexander Dubcek its chairman, followed by the text of his speech on taking the chair.
